spec.description: Retrieve OHLC market data. The last entry in the OHLC array is for the current, not-yet-committed timeframe, and will always be present, regardless of the value of `since`. Returns up to 720 of the most recent entries (older data cannot be retrieved, regardless of the value of `since`).

pair.description: Asset pair to get data for.

assetVersion.description: Controls whether response keys use Kraken's internal names or display names. Omitted (default): internal names are used. `assetVersion=1`: display names are used. Only `assetVersion=1` is currently supported.

since.description: Return OHLC entries since the given timestamp (intended for incremental updates).

asset_class.description: This parameter is required on requests for non-crypto pairs, i.e. use `tokenized_asset` for xstocks.

response.title: OhlcResultFrame
response.description: Wire frame; the generated method returns `result`.

error.description: Wire envelope field; see the core.

result.title: OhlcResult
result.description: OHLC candles, keyed by pair, plus the polling cursor.

last.description: ID to be used as `since` when polling for new, committed OHLC data.

additionalProperties.description: This pair's candles, oldest first. The last entry is the current, not-yet-committed timeframe.

notes: No pagination block: `since` is an incremental-update cursor, not a page walk -- the docs state older data cannot be retrieved regardless of `since`'s value, and the response is always capped at the 720 most recent candles, so there is no way to walk further back than that fixed window.
